newsitem.title: USA: Municipal bond sales total $406 mln for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Municipal bond sales total $406 mln for Thursday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Thursday are expected to total $406 million in 22 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $201 million in 9 sales, with a $65 million University of Pittsburgh deal topping the list from PNC Capital Markets.
On the competitive side, 13 sales totaling $204 million are on the schedule. Arlington, Texas' Independent School District's $65.5 million deal, set for 1400 EST, is the largest.
An additional two sales totaling $19 million are on the possible calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Thursday, depending on market conditions.
